question: What is long-term debt at year-end (0 if none)?
rationale: The best sampled-accuracy subset was the three-rule set combining the broad balance-sheet rule with the debt-note and selected-financial-data complements. It improves sampled match rate to 0.8 while dropping the zero-hit 8-K rule and the noisy MD&A rule; the full five-rule pool only reached 0.6 on this sampled set. The hard constraint could not be met under d-star-mode=all_labeled because AMAZON_2018_10K and LOCKHEEDMARTIN_2022_10K remained unsolved with the available rule pool, and the full pool itself missed more documents.
